titulo.estudio: Repérer la grammaire en contexte : Lire l'ensemble
titulo.alumno: Grammar in the text: Integrated reading

intro: Use articles, pronouns and negation to understand an everyday message. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Use articles, pronouns and negation to understand an everyday message. Match the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Watch out: when reading, the definite article can refer to a whole category; pronouns pick up a noun from earlier, and negation changes with the structure. In this passage, «aucun» means «none».

piezas.titulo: Key words: grammar in the text

frases.estudio: Au club, les membres peuvent emprunter des raquettes; les débutants n'en ont pas besoin.
frases.alumno: At the club, members can borrow rackets; beginners do not need them.

frases.estudio: L'entraîneuse leur explique les règles et leur montre le terrain.
frases.alumno: The coach explains the rules to them and shows them the court.

frases.estudio: Personne ne doit entrer sur le court avec des chaussures de ville.
frases.alumno: Nobody may go onto the court wearing street shoes.

frases.estudio: Aucun équipement n'est prêté après vingt heures, car le local ferme.
frases.alumno: No equipment is lent out after eight in the evening, because the club closes.
